label: AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 short-circuits nudgeDecision before the ratio, the loop check and the level, so a sandbox that inherits it gets no nudge at any fill.
relaunchSessionIsChild is a bare environment read, so nothing distinguishes a real dispatched child from a test process that inherited the variable.
The suppression is deliberate: a dispatched child owns no hand-over and a nudge there would ask it to write into the parent's packet.

The packet's completion criterion runs the history engine, hooks vitest, session readers and handover suites under env -u AI_SESSION_CHILD, the only way to get a nudge-capable environment from inside a child session.
commitNudge takes a per-session claim, re-runs nudgeDecision under it, writes the level and releases, so two racing hooks produce one delivery.
Only claude, codex and vibe use commitNudge; Pi and OpenCode call nudgeDecision directly and never take the claim.
Pi's substitute guard is the in-process heldNudges map, and deliverHeldNudge deletes the entry before sending, so turn_end then agent_end cannot double-deliver within one process.
OpenCode's substitute guard is state.pendingNudge, also in-process, so a plugin reload or a second host instance starts null and can deliver again.
Claude registers context-nudge.mjs on both UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse, which is exactly the two-hook shape the claim guard exists for.

direction: The double nudge is unguarded everywhere
reason: Three adapters take the claim and are safe; the gap is Pi and OpenCode only.

direction: AI_SESSION_CHILD can be ignored in tests because the nudge is not under test
reason: The nudge is the entry point of the whole hop, so a suppressed nudge means no note, no prepare and no hop.
